title: The Pentagon paid $21.9 million for warp drives, wormholes and invisibility cloaks: the receipts
parts:
The Pentagon paid $21,948,810 to study warp drives, wormholes and invisibility cloaks 🛸
The papers leaked years ago. The new part? The receipts.
DOW-UAP-D138 🧵

1/ July 2008. The Defense Intelligence Agency scopes AAWSAP: foreign aerospace threats "through the year 2050". The study list: lift, propulsion, control... and item 5, "spatial/temporal translation".
2/ Sept 2008. The contract goes to Bigelow Aerospace Advanced Space Studies, Las Vegas. Box 26, total award amount: $21,948,810.00. That's in the contract file the Pentagon just released.

3/ Out came 37 papers. "Warp Drive, Dark Energy, and the Manipulation of Extra Dimensions". "Traversable Wormholes, Stargates, and Negative Energy". "Antigravity for Aerospace Applications". "Invisibility Cloaking".

4/ The warp paper did the math. At 100x light speed: Mars in 193 seconds, Jupiter 36 min, Alpha Centauri 15 days, the Orion Nebula 1.3 years. It cites Star Trek by name, and calls the energy needed "phenomenally high".

5/ The dark one: injuries from "advanced energy systems". Its 42 + 300 cases are mostly known microwave exposures. And the Pentagon's own label for all 37: "reference and synthesis products rather than... original research".

6/ Read the receipts yourself, free:
• realufo.org/archive → search "AAWSAP"
• or search a phrase inside the PDFs, e.g. "Orion Nebula"
• the contract with the $21.9M total: DOW-UAP-D111

evidence.label: The receipt: $21,948,810.00 to Bigelow Aerospace Advanced Space Studies
evidence.evidence: Solicitation and original order, effective 22 Sep 2008, Virginia Contracting Activity (DIA). Offeror: Bigelow Aerospace Advanced Space Studies, LLC, Las Vegas NV. Box 26, total award amount: $21,948,810.00. Base year line items include $2,887,000 for monthly status reports. New in this release: the contract file (objectives, solicitation, five modifications).

evidence.label: The to-do list: threats "through the year 2050", item 5 "spatial/temporal translation"
evidence.evidence: Statement of Objectives, 18 July 2008: "understand the physics and engineering of these applications as they apply to the foreign threat out to the far term, i.e., from now through the year 2050". Study areas: lift, propulsion, control, power generation, spatial/temporal translation, materials, configuration, signature reduction, human interface, human effects, armament.

evidence.label: Warp drive: Mars in 193 seconds at 100x light speed
evidence.evidence: Table 1, transit times at 100x the speed of light: Mars 193 seconds, Jupiter 36 minutes, Neptune 4 hours, Alpha Centauri 15 days, Epsilon Eridani 38 days, the Orion Nebula 1.3 years. Cites Alcubierre's 1994 paper and "the warp drive from the popular Star Trek television series"; notes the energy requirement is "so phenomenally high".

evidence.label: The dark one: injuries blamed on "advanced energy systems"
evidence.evidence: "An extensive review of the medical literature ... has revealed an additional relevant but less dramatic 42 cases from the peer-reviewed medical literature, and an additional un-published similar 300 cases, primarily when fields were measured or emitters were known" (1-10 GHz). Yet: "The medical analyses ... do indicate the use of (to us) unconventional and advanced energy systems."

evidence.label: Traversable Wormholes, Stargates, and Negative Energy (2010)
evidence.evidence: AAWSAP DIRD, April 2010, 42 pages. Reviews wormhole physics and the exotic "negative energy" it would need. The Pentagon's note on every DIRD: "reference and synthesis products rather than ... original research", not "current validation of the concepts discussed".

evidence.label: Antigravity for Aerospace Applications (2010)
evidence.evidence: AAWSAP DIRD, March 2010, 44 pages: Newtonian, relativistic and quantum approaches to counteracting gravity for propulsion.

evidence.label: Invisibility Cloaking: Theory and Experiments (2010)
evidence.evidence: AAWSAP DIRD, March 2010, 29 pages: camouflage, transparency and metamaterial cloaking.
